title: US Math Scores Fell To 270
closing: Students who miss foundational math face harder courses later, making this decline expensive to ignore.
question: Did your math skills recover?

segments.say: US math scores fell to 271. Decades of improvement were nearly erased.
The weakest students lost 14 points. The decline widened the gap between struggling students and everyone else.
US math scores slipped to 270. Years later, the promised recovery still has not arrived.
